Overview

Stuttgart is a city in Baden-Württemberg with a population of 630,000. The cradle of the automobile, home to Mercedes-Benz and Porsche, surrounded by vineyards and forested hills. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
